name: Partial Equivalence Queries Complexity of Addressing
proof: Query the partial hypothesis that labels every address point negative and is undefined on the bit points.  For target concept $i$, its unique positive address point $i$ is the only possible counterexample, so the reply identifies the target in one query.  A nontrivial class cannot be identified with zero queries.
references: Directly from the addressing-class definition; this is also the $\mathrm{LC}_{\mathrm{partial}}(\mathrm{ADDRESSING}_n)=1$ entry in \cite{maass1992lower}.
